# Yoink

Yoink turns product calls from trusted sources into bounded cart actions in a paired Chrome companion.

User documentation: /docs
User dashboard: /#cart
Chrome companion settings: /#setup/chrome
Running version: {{YOINK_VERSION}}

Canonical shopper routes:
- /#cart
- /#cart/calls
- /#cart/calls/drawings
- /#cart/calls/discord
- /#cart/history
- /#find
- /#setup
- /#setup/stores
- /#setup/chrome
- /#setup/discord
- /#setup/alerts
- /#setup/limits
- /#setup/data

Legacy aliases #home, #products, #stores, #calls, #plans, #activity, #activity/insights, #settings, #settings/chrome, #settings/notifications, #settings/privacy, #preferences, #connections, #health, and #diagnostics are canonicalized by the dashboard.

Current action boundary:
- Provider-neutral signal_event_v1 intake with configured per-channel trust and replay bounds.
- On a Windows PC, Discord messages shown as Windows notifications become calls, each traced to one product by store link (product page, add-to-cart link, affiliate link, or a followed short link), item number, a shopper-linked name, or name; a linked store item not yet in Yoink is added to the catalog; each channel can add to cart, log only, or be ignored. A Discord call with no price is checked on the store page against the shopper's max.
- Opt-in drop-window watches that only observe the store page in the paired Chrome session and never click.
- Each trusted call must match one exact store product.
- Saved price, seller, delivery, quantity, and spending limits.
- Fresh DOM revalidation in the user's paired Chrome session.
- At most one Add-to-cart click at a store the user turned on after its store checks pass.
- Calls never create plans; only Want it does.
- Exact cart +1 proof before a cart-ready handoff.
- Checkout stays manual; payment, order submission, raffles, and challenge handling require the user.

Explicitly unsupported:
- CAPTCHA or queue evasion.
- Proxy or request-mode store mutations.
- Third-party seller cart actions.
- Automatic checkout or order submission.

Primary user action stages:
- queued
- checking
- ready_to_checkout
- needs_you
- closed

Machine API prefix: /api/v1
The API is authenticated and permission-scoped. Chrome companion routes require a paired Chrome companion credential and approved extension origin.
